#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Sorry I couldn’t help you choose something this time…
Lady Annalie: I’m a disgrace of a saleswoman…
You: I-It’s not your fault! I was just looking around, I didn’t have anything specific in mind when I came here.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Is that so? Well, I hope something will catch your attention next time!
